name: Shenyang Mahjong
description: Shenyang Mahjong is a northeast China Mahjong variant associated with Shenyang and Liaoning region play. It keeps the core draw-discard meld structure while applying local table conventions for win validity and scoring emphasis.

overview.description: Shenyang Mahjong is a northeast China Mahjong variant associated with Shenyang and Liaoning region play. It keeps the core draw-discard meld structure while applying local table conventions for win validity and scoring emphasis.

history.origins: Shenyang Mahjong developed as a regional rule profile within broader Chinese Mahjong traditions and spread through local social play.
timeline: 20th century: regional rule agreements become consistent within local groups.
Modern era: digital rulesets document commonly used profiles.
history.cultural: It is played in community and family settings, typically with agreed scoring tables before play begins.
history.evolution: The shared Mahjong hand structure is retained while table profiles adjust scoring and validity expectations.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand that satisfies the active Shenyang scoring profile.
rules.gameplay: Players take turns drawing one tile from the wall and discarding one tile. Other players may claim a discard for a legal meld based on claim priority and restrictions. A player wins when their tiles form a complete hand and the scoring profile permits the win.
keyRules: Default action loop is draw then discard.
Claims for melds must be legal and follow priority rules.
Winning requires a complete 14-tile hand and profile-accepted validity.

strategy.basic: Maintain flexible shapes and do not lock into a narrow wait too early.
strategy.intermediate: Use visible discards to infer tile scarcity and reduce risky discards under threat.
strategy.advanced: Profile-aware play balances speed, value, and defense when opponents show commitment.
tips: Treat honor tiles as higher commitment; discard early if they do not fit your route.
When opponents accelerate, choose safer discards even if it slows your completion.

synthesis.shortDescription: Shenyang Mahjong is a Liaoning regional Mahjong profile using classic draw-discard meld play with local scoring conventions.
